description: We are a team of passionate students and technology enthusiasts interested in space exploration and interactive learning. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to build an engaging Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that introduces children to astronaut missions through fun, interactive, and educational experiences.
summary:
**COSMIX — Beyond the Known Universe 🚀**

COSMIX is an interactive, browser-based 3D space exploration and astronaut simulation platform that allows players to experience life beyond Earth. Players take on the role of astronauts and explore two immersive environments: the Moon’s Lunar Frontier and Mars Frontier. They can complete missions, investigate planetary landscapes, scan objects, collect scientific samples and build sustainable colonies. The game features resource management and construction systems, allowing players to develop habitats, greenhouses, solar power stations, research laboratories and other essential facilities while facing environmental challenges like dust storms. Additionally, its Learning Lab offers six educational mini-games covering planetary science, lunar gravity, rover navigation, resource management, solar energy and Martian agriculture. Built with Three.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, GSAP and Vite, COSMIX combines exploration, simulation and education to make the future of space exploration an interactive experience.
details:
COSMIX — Beyond the Known Universe 🚀

COSMIX is an interactive, browser-based 3D space exploration and astronaut mission-training platform that transforms space science into an immersive, hands-on experience. Players take on the role of astronauts and explore two planetary environments: the Moon's Lunar Frontier and Mars Frontier. They can investigate unfamiliar landscapes, scan objects, collect scientific samples, complete exploration missions and establish sustainable colonies beyond Earth.

The platform combines planetary exploration with resource management and colony construction, allowing players to develop astronaut habitats, agricultural greenhouses, solar power stations, research laboratories and water extraction systems while experiencing environmental challenges such as lunar and Martian dust storms.

COSMIX also includes a Learning Lab featuring six interactive mini-games focused on lunar gravity, crater formation, Mars rover navigation, mission resource management, solar energy and Martian agriculture.

Developed using Three.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, GSAP and Vite, the project integrates real-time 3D visualisation, interactive simulations, animations and educational gameplay.

Our creative approach is to combine entertainment with experiential learning, making complex space exploration concepts more accessible and engaging. We considered scientific learning, user interaction, accessibility, resource sustainability and the challenges of establishing human settlements beyond Earth.

Our goal is to inspire curiosity about space and help people experience the possibilities and challenges of humanity's future beyond Earth.--
